summaries.Romania: Romania faces critical healthcare infrastructure gaps with neurologists unavailable in a major county, while energy stability concerns persist amid high temperatures and efforts to finalize PNRR commitments. Constitutional Court decisions on anti-corruption laws continue to spark political controversy.
summaries.Healthcare: Meta faces a major lawsuit alleging intentional creation of youth addiction on Facebook and Instagram, while healthcare systems grapple with rising costs and staffing challenges, and FDA leadership transitions create uncertainty.
summaries.Tech: Apple unveils major EU App Store reforms and leaks reveal upcoming products including camera-equipped AirPods, while competitors like Peacock and Comcast expand services with price increases and new capabilities respectively.

items.title: Singurul județ din România cu 700.000 de locuitori nu mai are medic de gardă la Neurologie. „Trimitem pacienți cu AVC zeci de kilometri cu ambulanța”
items.snippet: La aproximativ 70 de kilometri de București, un spital de urgență – singurul dintr-un județ cu 750.000 de locuitori ­- nu mai are de câțiva ani medici neurologi care să facă gărzi. items.line: A county of 750,000 people lacks on-call neurologists to handle stroke cases, forcing emergency transport over 70km away.

items.title: Apple overhauls its EU App Store fees, loosens rules for alternative app stores
items.snippet: Apple is simplifying its EU App Store fees, replacing its per-install fee with a 5% commission for apps distributed outside the App Store and making it easier for developers to operate alternative app marketplaces.
items.line: Apple overhauls EU App Store with simplified 5% commission and easier alternative store distribution to comply with Digital Markets Act.

items.title: Instagram și Facebook s-ar putea schimba pentru totdeauna dacă Meta pierde un proces uriaș în SUA

items.line: Meta faces a landmark lawsuit from 30 US states alleging intentional addiction targeting of minors on Facebook and Instagram.

items.snippet: FCC demands "total capitulation" in Trump censorship campaign, Disney suit says.

items.snippet: Comcast is bringing Wi-Fi motion sensing to millions of routers that are already in customers' homes, turning the devices into activity monitors. items.title: STAT+: Leaders of Mass General, Dana-Farber among hospital execs who got big raises in 2024
items.snippet: Top executives of major health systems got substantial raises, even as their hospitals grappled with plenty of challenges.
items.line: Hospital executives including Mass General and Dana-Farber leadership received substantial raises despite system-wide healthcare challenges.

items.title: România este pe ultimul loc în UE la cheltuielile publice pentru educaţie (Eurostat)
items.snippet: Cheltuielile publice pentru educaţie (de la grădiniţă şi până la liceu) în Uniunea Europeană au reprezentat 4,7% din produsul intern brut (PIB) în anul 2023, o cifră care nu a suferit modificări față de 2022, arată datele publicate marţi de Eurostat. România se află la coada clasamentului.
items.line: Romania spends the least on public education in the EU at significantly below the 4.7% EU average of GDP.
